title: zoo-downloader site module manifest
description: manifest.json of a zoo-downloader site module (API level 2). The user sees name, description and the permissions before installing.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editor completion. Ignored by the app.

apiVersion.description: The API level the module is written against: this SDK's (3). An app runs every level from the oldest it supports up to its own, so a module on a newer level than an app shows there as needing a newer Zoo Downloader. Level 2 added credentialsHelp, help, helpUrl and translated labels; level 3 added zoo.ask.

id.description: Unique within its marketplace; lowercase letters, digits and '-'. Installed modules are identified as id@marketplace.

description.description: One or two sentences shown in the module list.

homepage.description: Where users can read about or report problems with the module.

entry.description: Relative path of the bundled single-file ES module.

urlPatterns.description: Share-page URLs this module resolves. '*' matches any run of characters; a host starting with '*.' also matches subdomains. Matching never runs module code.

urlRegex.description: Optional. Narrows urlPatterns: a URL must also match this regular expression (Rust regex syntax: no lookaround or backreferences). The fragment is removed first.

autoStart.description: A copied link may start downloading at once instead of opening the add-download page, when the user allows it. Leave false for sites that usually ask for a captcha.

credentialsHelp.description: Optional. Shown above the account fields: where the values come from (e.g. which page to sign in to).

credentialsHelpUrl.description: Optional. A page explaining the account fields further; the user opens it from the account dialog.

permissions.description: Everything the module may do beyond computing. Shown to the user for consent; asking for more in an update requires consent again.

allowDomains.description: Hosts fetch may reach. Each entry also covers its subdomains ('k2s.cc' covers 'api.k2s.cc'). No schemes, paths or ports. Private and local addresses are always blocked.

credentials.description: Account fields the user is asked for. The module only ever sees placeholders (zoo.credentials.placeholder).

label.description: Field label shown to the user.

optional.description: The module works without it (e.g. free downloads); check zoo.credentials.has(key).

help.description: Optional. Shown under the field: how to get the value.

helpUrl.description: Optional. A page explaining how to get this value.

label.$comment: at most 80 characters: maxLength for a string, additionalProperties for one per language

help.$comment: at most 300 characters: maxLength for a string, additionalProperties for one per language

longHelp.$comment: at most 500 characters: maxLength for a string, additionalProperties for one per language

text.description:
Text shown to the user: one string, or one per language, e.g. { "en": "Password", "zh-TW": "密碼", "ja": "パスワード" }. The app shows the user's language, else en, else the first. Line breaks (
) and spaces are shown as written.
